phase: Phase R2 Task 2 adversarial fixtures — omission and tamper corpus

fixtures.name: omit-route
fixtures.description: Omit one route entry from routeReconciliation; the resulting count must drop below 665 and fail any compensating 17-route minimum assertion.

fixtures.name: omit-field
fixtures.description: Omit one field entry from fieldReconciliation; the resulting count must drop below 3306.

fixtures.name: duplicate-field
fixtures.description: Append a duplicate field entry to fieldReconciliation; the unique-id set must shrink by one.

fixtures.name: duplicate-route
fixtures.description: Append a duplicate route entry to routeReconciliation.

fixtures.name: tamper-field-source-range
fixtures.description: Replace one field entry's sourceRangeSha256 with zero-bytes; the frozen R1 archive replay must produce a different digest.

fixtures.name: tamper-route-line-range
fixtures.description: Mutate one route entry's lineStart/lineEnd to an out-of-range span; the frozen R1 archive replay must produce a different digest.

fixtures.name: tamper-symbol-digest
fixtures.description: Replace the canonical symbol-set SHA-256 with zero-bytes; the recomputed digest must differ.

fixtures.name: tamper-symbol-count
fixtures.description: Decrement the total unaudited count by one; the fieldCount + routeCount sum must no longer match.

fixtures.name: tamper-two-scan-identity
fixtures.description: Diverge the first and second scan inventory digests; the equality invariant must fail.

fixtures.name: tamper-audit-exit-code
fixtures.description: Set the preserved audit exit code to 0; the compensation label and exit code must remain mismatched.

fixtures.name: tamper-compensation-label
fixtures.description: Relabel the decision branch from COMPENSATION_REQUIRED to CLEAN; the source-attempt decision binding must diverge.
